    <script>

        var counter = 0;
        function loadMany() {

            var milletvekiliAramaVM = $('#aramakriterleri').val();
            var totalSize = $('#totalsizehidden').val();

            var pageIndex = ++counter;

            $.ajax({
                headers: { "X-CSRF-TOKEN-TBMM-WEB-Mvc-Prod": "CfDJ8BEKJxiq2epEvSH0rDefhNA6SZ0BiaKcO7HtS8JrZIdoVs438yf3GzzZ_ynFfUeTx5l57eDFaIpd5IwT8hjEz4yO895Chj-SqpewE3AicGL58G4WnNFo8vMahY4SeuEnLL7i0v-OU110XrhKK3WO52g" },
                type: "POST",
                url: "/MilletvekiliArama/LoadUye",
                data: { milletvekiliAramaVM: JSON.parse(milletvekiliAramaVM), pageIndex: pageIndex, totalSize: totalSize },
                success: function(result) {
                    $('#totalSize').remove();
                    $("#uyeList").append(result);
                }
            });

        }

        $(document).ready(function() {

            var url = window.location.href.toLowerCase();

            if (url.includes("sandalyedagilimi")) {
                $('#loadbtn').remove();
                $('#totalsize').remove();
            }
        });

    </script>
